headline: Cathie Wood Scoops $16 Million of Broadcom Ahead of a Crucial AI Earnings Test
summary: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest bought $16 million of Broadcom ahead of earnings, betting on the AI chipmaker as AI infrastructure spending accelerates.

headline: Everyone Is Chasing Nvidia: BofA Securities Sees $210 Billion CPU Boom for These 3 Stocks
summary: BofA Securities sees AI agents driving server CPU demand to $210 billion by 2030, with AMD, Intel and ARM positioned for the next AI wave.

headline: AMD Prepares Record $5B Bond Sale to Fuel Massive AI Expansion
summary: Advanced Micro Devices plans a record $5 billion bond sale to fund aggressive AI infrastructure investments, refinance debt, and power key partnerships with Microsoft and Anthropic.

headline: Nebius Says AI Compute Prices Jumped 15%, Signaling Strong Pricing Power
summary: Nebius says its first AI capacity auction cleared 15% above its previous highest price, suggesting customers are willing to pay more for scarce AI computing power.
